scope: Original thematic guided reading of selected entries of Sei Shōnagon’s Pillow Book, primarily Koten Library Shunshoshō-line 1903 Japanese edition: seasons, lists, animal and court anecdotes, political and aesthetic context.
editorial_boundary: Selections correspond to Koten Library section labels in the Japanese 1903 Shunshoshō line, NOT a universally original order. Waley 1928 translated about one-quarter; no one English witness covers every section; reception and political context kept separate.
